items.description: STEL Order is an invoicing web application that provides businesses a way to securely synchronize their data on the cloud. This application uses Fakturoid API.
The CNN iReports Map, set on the Barack Obama inauguration parade route, allows readers to submit their own stories and reports from the event.
Map of the home towns of US female casualties of the Iraq War.
An nice explorative Flash-based interface into Flickr photos. With tag search, interestingness sorting, user tabs, and related tags.
This tool uses Foursquare to allow users to rate public restrooms.

Designed for those who don't have time or simply don't want to log recurring activities, FitTap is a solution that lets customers log activities such as food & water intake, sleep, and weight changes. Users may do this by scanning custom NFC-tags with their NFC-enabled smartphone. To use this application, customers are required to purchase custom-made tags from the App Store.
Combination of Mediawiki and Google Maps to manage location based data about Dutch cultural heritage.
Gothamist Maps are a great way to see what is going on and where right now in NYC.
The MailChimp Wordpress plugin allows you to add your MailChimp email signup form as a widget on your Wordpress blog.
Mashup to easily share your Flickr photos on Twitter.
Multiple maps of data for New York City from government sources.
dr. Nescio is a application that automatically indexes and ranks cities based on individual sights, like museums, parks, hotels, bars and music venues.
Docklands Station in Dublin. This map with contours that represent the 3-minute walking time bands from the new station.

The purpose of this site is to help users instantly search for Youtube videos and instantly create playlists. You can also share your custom playlists easily with your friends on Facebook or Twitter as well as embed your playlists on your own websites or blogs. Lastly, you can save your playlists for future use all without the need of registration or login. -Easily create, embed and share YouTube playlists. -No sign up needed. -Embed the playlist on your blog easily.

hearSay lets you make recorded phone calls from an anonymous number using only your web browser. hearSay uses Twilio Client to connect the user to any US number, then emails the user a recording of the call automatically. No sign up or login required.
Guidespot.com is about Conspiracy America. It is a coast-to-coast tour, a fun-filled look at the current state of National Paranoia.
Speed Dial Group Messaging allows you to quickly get in touch with your group. You make one phone call, record your message, and we send it out to your entire group by voice, e-mail or text message.
Connected is a personal relationship manager that brings your contacts and conversations together from email, social networks, calendar and phone.
Browse photos by Arab country name.
Plots points and tracks from GPX files onto Virtual Earth maps.
Real estate listings of land for sale in Texas using Google Maps.
